text:
Predicates:
Timeless(x) ::: x is a timeless design.
MassProduct(x) ::: x is a mass product design.
DesignStyle(x, y) ::: x's design style is y.
Evocative(x) ::: x is evocative.
Dreamy(x) ::: x is dreamy.
Premises:
∀x (DesignStyle(zahaHadid, x) → Timeless(x)) ::: All of Zaha Hadid's design styles are timeless.
∀x (¬Timeless(x) → ¬MassProduct(x)) ::: No mass product design is timeless.
DesignStyle(zahaHadid, zahaHadid) ∨ DesignStyle(zahaHadid, kellyWearstler) ::: Either Zaha Hadid's design style or Kelly Wearstler's design style.
∀x (DesignStyle(kellyWearstler, x) → Evocative(x)) ::: All of Kelly Wearstler's design styles are evocative.
∀x (DesignStyle(kellyWearstler, x) → Dreamy(x)) ::: All of Kelly Wearstler's design styles are dreamy.
Timeless(designMax) → (MassProduct(designMax) ∧ Evocative(designMax)) ::: If a design by Max is timeless, then a design by Max is a mass product design and evocative.
Conclusion:
Evocative(designMax) ∨ Dreamy(designMax) ::: A design by Max is either evocative or dreamy.
